text: Kaa ko on ɗoftiiɗo Allah, feƴƴiniroowo jemma on, sujjangol Mo, darorana Mo naafe, hara himo huli lepte laakara ɗen, himo jortrii yurmeende Joomi makko nden, kaa ko yedduɗo rewoowo Allah on ka saɗteende tun, o yedda Mo ka hoyeende, o waɗana Mo kafidiiɗi? An Nulaaɗo, maaku : Hara ɓen annduɓe ko Allah farli kon e maɓɓe, hino fota e ɓen ɓe anndaa huunde e ɗum? Anndu ko taskotoo kon ko senndi ɗin feddeeji ɗiɗi, ko joomiraaɓe haqqille hisuɗe ɗen.
